title: BiasDPO: Mitigating Bias in Language Models through Direct Preference Optimization
benchmark_measurement: Detection and mitigation of stereotypes and biases in religious contexts, particularly in question answering and open-ended text generation.
findings: The proposed model (Phi-2 + BiasDPO) improved accuracy on the BBQ benchmark for religion (0.69 vs 0.54 for the baseline), second only to Mistral-7B. However, on the BOLD benchmark, its toxicity score for religion (0.0613) was higher (worse) than the baseline model (0.0469) and other competitor models.
references: Mohammad Gheshlaghi Azar, Mark Rowland, Bilal Piot, Daniel Guo, Daniele Calandriello, Michal Valko, and Rémi Munos. 2023. A general theoretical paradigm to understand learning from human preferences.
